doc_001.title: Metro Rail Safety Guidelines 2024
doc_001.author: KMRL Safety Department

doc_001.summary: Comprehensive safety guidelines for metro rail operations including new emergency procedures, passenger safety protocols, and staff training requirements. This document covers updated safety measures in response to recent regulatory changes and best practices from other metro systems.
